## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Issue and scope are correct; no duplicate task.
- [ ] Diff contains only authorized changes.
- [ ] Existing functionality has not been removed without approval.
- [ ] Tests and evidence are credible and reproducible.
- [ ] CI is green.
- [ ] Documentation and operational instructions are updated.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or personal data were committed.
